questions.question_text: In a tournament of $15$ players, in how many ways can first and second place be awarded?

options.why: Divided by 2, treating the two distinct places as an unordered selection.
Calculated 15 squared, allowing the same player to win both places.
Multiplied 15 by 2 instead of multiplying descending factors 15 and 14.

questions.solution_text:
Number of ways to award first and second place:
$= {^{15}P_{2}}$
$= 15 \times 14$
$= 210$
